items.title: Bill Charlap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: We’ve played two pianos once, one song. And it was like that immediately.

ctx.x: Scale knowledge. Rhythmic knowledge. Historical knowledge. Everything. Absolutely. Absolutely. You have to have a full tool box or you won’t be able to build the house.
When you’re playing in a situation like you did this afternoon with Roland Hanna, there was some pretty adventurous things that happened between you two. Had you guys done that before?

We’ve played two pianos once, one song. And it was like that immediately. And that was many years ago, so, not that many, maybe two or three. You listen. We have a frame of reference. We can talk about things musically. He can play a chord and I know what chord he’s playing. Or he can get into a rhythmic idea or a feel or a groove, and I know what he’s talking about.
